---
title: "LRSomatic — per-sample genomics report"
date: today
format:
  html:
    self-contained: true
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 3
    toc-location: left
    theme: [flatly, ../assets/styles/report.scss]
    code-fold: true
    page-layout: full
    # The reader's light/dark choice (header toggle, templates/sections/_header.qmd), applied
    # before first paint so a dark pick does not flash light; same storage key in both places
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <script>try { var t = localStorage.getItem("lrsomatic-report-theme"); if (t === "light" || t === "dark") document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", t); } catch (e) {}</script>
params:
  sample_id:     "SAMPLE"
  sample_dir:    ""
  reference:     "t2t"
  sex:           "female"
  default_panels: "__all__" # panel keys checked on load; "__all__" = none checked
  all_panels:    NULL   # named list from load_all_gene_panels()
  title:         "LRSomatic Report"
  repo_dir:      "."
  outputs:       NULL   # named list from locate_outputs()
  embed:         "slim" # --embed: "slim" embeds the relevant small-variant rows, "full" all
  embed_full_table: true # --embed-full-table: the sidecar's bytes go into the HTML too
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(dplyr)
  library(DT)
  library(htmltools)
  library(ggplot2)
})

repo_dir = params$repo_dir
source(file.path(repo_dir, "R/utils.R"))
source(file.path(repo_dir, "R/references.R"))
source(file.path(repo_dir, "R/locate_outputs.R"))
source(file.path(repo_dir, "R/parse_smallvariants.R"))
source(file.path(repo_dir, "R/parse_severus.R"))
source(file.path(repo_dir, "R/parse_padfoot.R"))
source(file.path(repo_dir, "R/parse_ascat.R"))
source(file.path(repo_dir, "R/parse_qc.R"))
source(file.path(repo_dir, "R/circos.R"))
source(file.path(repo_dir, "R/circos_bnd.R"))

source(file.path(repo_dir, "R/sections.R"))
# SECTION_ORDER, not alphabetical: registration order is parse order (see R/sections.R)
for (f in section_files(file.path(repo_dir, "R/sections"))) {
  source(f)
}
source(file.path(repo_dir, "R/key_findings.R"))

outputs = params$outputs
sample_id = params$sample_id
sample_dir = params$sample_dir
embed = if (!is.null(params$embed)) as.character(params$embed) else "slim"
all_panels = if (!is.null(params$all_panels) && length(params$all_panels) > 0)
               params$all_panels else list()

# Load reference data (before the sections, so ctx can carry it)
cytobands    = load_cytobands(params$reference, file.path(repo_dir, "assets"))
chrom_lens   = load_chrom_lengths(params$reference, file.path(repo_dir, "assets"))
chromosomes  = chromosomes_for_sex(params$sex)
chromosomes  = chromosomes[chromosomes %in% unique(cytobands$chrom)]

# Optional third parse() argument; field list documented in R/sections.R
ctx = list(
  sample_id   = sample_id,
  sample_dir  = sample_dir,
  reference   = params$reference,
  sex         = params$sex,
  all_panels  = all_panels,
  chromosomes = chromosomes,
  chrom_lens  = chrom_lens,
  cytobands   = cytobands,
  embed       = embed,
  repo_dir    = repo_dir,
  outputs     = outputs
)

# Section-module contract: each section owns locate() and parse(); see CLAUDE.md
SECTION_DATA = list()
for (s in SECTIONS) {
  SECTION_DATA[[s$id]] = run_section_parse(s, s$locate(sample_dir, sample_id), SECTION_DATA, ctx)
}

# Which panels are checked on load travels to the browser as DEFAULT_PANELS; nothing server-side reads them any more, and bin/render_report.R has already rejected an unresolvable one

# Parse ASCAT
ascat_segments = parse_ascat_segments(outputs$ascat_segments)
ascat_pp       = parse_ascat_purityploidy(outputs$ascat_purityploidy)

# Parse Wakhan

# Parse QC
qc_mosdepth = parse_mosdepth_summary(outputs$mosdepth_summary, names(chrom_lens))
qc_mosdist  = parse_mosdepth_dist(outputs$mosdepth_dist)
qc_cramino  = parse_cramino(outputs$cramino)
qc_flagstat = parse_flagstat(outputs$flagstat)
samtools_stats = parse_samtools_stats(outputs$samtools_stats)
qc_normal_mosdepth = parse_mosdepth_summary(outputs$normal_mosdepth_summary, names(chrom_lens))
qc_normal_cramino  = parse_cramino(outputs$normal_cramino)
qc_normal_flagstat = parse_flagstat(outputs$normal_flagstat)
qc_normal_samtools_stats = parse_samtools_stats(outputs$normal_samtools_stats)

# Parse VEP + raw callers
vep_data = parse_vep(outputs$vep_somatic)

vaf_data = parse_caller_vcf(outputs$somatic_vaf_vcf, "somatic", sample_id = params$sample_id)

# Source of the VAF/DP/GT/PS columns, for the footnote (ambiguous after a consensus merge)
vaf_prov = vaf_provenance(outputs$somatic_vaf_vcf, sample_dir, sample_id = params$sample_id)

# variant_table is the FULL table: TMB, n_vaf, n_multi, header counts and the overview read it
variant_table = build_variant_table(vep_data, vaf_data, gene_panel = NULL)
tmb_info = compute_tmb(variant_table)

# Small-variant counts (SNV vs indel) for the header card. NB: "sv" = small variants here,
# not structural variants (those are SECTION_DATA$sv)
sv_counts = count_small_variants(vep_data)

# Rows embedded in the HTML table (--embed slim|full); the full table goes to a sidecar
variant_embed = slim_variant_table(variant_table, all_panels, embed)
# Written next to the rendered document (knitr's working directory, the .qmd's directory);
# bin/render_report.R moves it next to the output HTML
small_variants_tsv = paste0(sample_id, "_small_variants.tsv.gz")
if (!is.null(variant_table)) write_full_variant_table(variant_table, small_variants_tsv)
# The same bytes embedded for the download / show-all controls, unless off or over the size cap
embed_full_table = if (is.null(params$embed_full_table)) TRUE else
                     isTRUE(as.logical(unlist(params$embed_full_table)))
full_table = full_table_payload(small_variants_tsv,
                                enabled = embed_full_table && !is.null(variant_table))

# Join coverage: a silently failing variant_key() shows up here as a near-zero count
n_vaf = if (!is.null(variant_table) && "vaf" %in% names(variant_table))
          sum(!is.na(variant_table$vaf)) else NA_integer_
# Variants reported by more than one caller; always 0 on the VEP text path
n_multi = if (!is.null(variant_table) && "callers" %in% names(variant_table))
            sum(grepl(",", variant_table$callers, fixed = TRUE)) else 0L

# SNV data for circos (from VEP file — contains all somatic variants)
snv_circos = NULL
if (!is.null(vep_data) && nrow(vep_data) > 0) {
  snv_circos = unique(vep_data[, .(chrom, pos, ref, alt)])
}

# Summary counts
sv_table = SECTION_DATA$sv$table
# All small variants (SNVs + indels), unique chrom/pos/ref/alt; kept under its old name
n_snv        = sv_counts$total
# One rearrangement per row (mates already collapsed). With two SV callers the table holds
# both, so the header counts come from the primary caller only (never the sum of callers).
sv_primary_caller = SECTION_DATA$sv$circos_caller
sv_primary = if (!is.null(sv_table) && nrow(sv_table) > 0 && "caller" %in% names(sv_table) &&
                 length(sv_primary_caller) == 1 && !is.na(sv_primary_caller))
               sv_table[caller == sv_primary_caller] else sv_table
n_sv         = if (!is.null(sv_primary) && nrow(sv_primary) > 0) nrow(sv_primary) else
               if (!is.null(SECTION_DATA$sv))
                 nrow(SECTION_DATA$sv$circos$nontrans) +
                 nrow(SECTION_DATA$sv$circos$translocations) else NA_integer_
# Interchromosomal breakends, apart from the intra-chromosomal ones
n_trans      = if (!is.null(sv_primary) && "svclass" %in% names(sv_primary))
                 sum(sv_primary$svclass == "translocation", na.rm = TRUE) else NA_integer_
n_intra_bnd  = if (!is.null(sv_primary) && "svclass" %in% names(sv_primary))
                 sum(sv_primary$svclass == "intra-chr breakend", na.rm = TRUE) else NA_integer_

# Clinical overview (R/key_findings.R); rendered by sections/_overview.qmd
report_counts = list(small_variants = sv_counts, n_sv = n_sv,
                     n_trans = n_trans, n_intra_bnd = n_intra_bnd,
                     sv_caller = sv_primary_caller)
OVERVIEW = build_overview(variant_table, SECTION_DATA, all_panels, ascat_pp, tmb_info,
                          report_counts, ctx)

# Genome circos, after the overview: its driver labels are the overview's tier 1-2 findings
# (circos_driver_rows() in R/key_findings.R). Drawn to a temp SVG that sections/_circos.qmd
# embeds as base64; the labels are drawn over it in the browser (assets/js/circos_drivers.js)
circos_labels = circos_driver_rows(OVERVIEW$findings)
circos_loci = circos_label_loci(circos_labels$label, all_panels, SECTION_DATA, variant_table)
# Copy-number ring: the CN section's source (Wakhan, else ASCAT), as in the overview
circos_cn = circos_cn_segments(SECTION_DATA$cna, ascat_segments)
circos_tmp = tempfile(fileext = ".svg")
circos_res = NULL
tryCatch({
  circos_res = draw_circos(
    snv_data    = snv_circos,
    sv_nontrans = SECTION_DATA$sv$circos$nontrans,
    sv_trans    = SECTION_DATA$sv$circos$translocations,
    cnv_data    = if (!is.null(circos_cn)) circos_cn$segments,
    cytobands   = cytobands,
    chrom_lengths = chrom_lens,
    chromosomes = chromosomes,
    output_path = circos_tmp,
    label_loci  = circos_loci
  )
}, error = function(e) {
  message("Circos plot failed: ", e$message)
  circos_tmp <<- NULL
})
```

```{r panel-js-data, results='asis'}
all_p = if (!is.null(params$all_panels) && length(params$all_panels) > 0)
          params$all_panels else list()

# Each panel ships both symbol sets (`applies_to` scopes them per table; equal when the
# panel has no such column) and, if coordinate-carrying, intervals — already SV-scoped by
# load_gene_panel(). Windows come from R (SV_PANEL_WINDOW_*) so filter and footnote agree
#
# unlist(): a panel scoped entirely to one table leaves the other set empty, and an empty
# character vector round-trips through execute_params as NULL (see bin/render_report.R)
js_set = function(x) paste0("new Set([",
                            paste(js_quote(toupper(as.character(unlist(x)))), collapse = ","),
                            "])")

panel_defs = vapply(names(all_p), function(nm) {
  p    = all_p[[nm]]
  syms = js_set(if (isTRUE(unlist(p$has_scopes))) p$genes_snv else if (!is.null(p$genes_snv)) p$genes_snv else p$genes)
  syms_sv = js_set(if (!is.null(p$genes_sv)) p$genes_sv else p$genes)
  ivs  = if (isTRUE(p$has_coords))
    paste0("[", paste(sprintf("[%s,%s,%s,%s]",
                              js_quote(p$chrom), as.integer(p$start), as.integer(p$end),
                              js_quote(toupper(as.character(p$interval_gene)))),
                      collapse = ","), "]")
  else "[]"
  sprintf("%s: {symbols: %s, symbolsSv: %s, hasCoords: %s, intervals: %s}",
          js_quote(nm), syms, syms_sv,
          if (isTRUE(p$has_coords)) "true" else "false", ivs)
}, character(1))

cat("<script>\n")
cat("const GENE_PANELS = {", paste(panel_defs, collapse = ",\n"), "};\n", sep = "")
default_panels = setdiff(as.character(unlist(params$default_panels)), "__all__")
# js_vec(): an empty selection must emit [], not [""]
cat("const DEFAULT_PANELS = ", js_vec(default_panels), ";\n", sep = "")
cat("const SV_PANEL_WINDOW_BND = ",   format(SV_PANEL_WINDOW_BND,   scientific = FALSE), ";\n", sep = "")
cat("const SV_PANEL_WINDOW_OTHER = ", format(SV_PANEL_WINDOW_OTHER, scientific = FALSE), ";\n", sep = "")
cat("const BND_SVTYPES = [", paste(js_quote(BND_SVTYPES), collapse = ","), "];\n", sep = "")
cat(r"----(
// Checked panels, shared by the filter hook, row counter, panel_hit renderer and SV footnote; column maps come from R (window.*_COLS). Empty `panels` is the unfiltered state
window.svPanelState = { panels: DEFAULT_PANELS.slice(), customGenes: new Set() };

// Every checked panel as {name, symbols, symbolsSv, hasCoords, intervals}; a row passes if it hits any (union).
// `symbols` filters small variants, `symbolsSv` the SV table's symbol-only path — they differ
// only for a panel carrying an `applies_to` column. Intervals arrive already SV-scoped from R
function activePanelDefs() {
  const st = window.svPanelState;
  const out = [];
  (st.panels || []).forEach(function (key) {
    if (key === "__custom__") {
      // Pasted symbols are symbol-only and unscoped: they filter both tables
      if (st.customGenes && st.customGenes.size > 0)
        out.push({ name: "custom", symbols: st.customGenes, symbolsSv: st.customGenes,
                   hasCoords: false, intervals: [] });
      return;
    }
    const p = GENE_PANELS[key];
    if (p) out.push({ name: key, symbols: p.symbols, symbolsSv: p.symbolsSv,
                      hasCoords: p.hasCoords, intervals: p.intervals });
  });
  return out;
}

function splitGenes(cell) {
  if (cell === null || cell === undefined) return [];
  return String(cell).toUpperCase().split(/[;,]+/)
    .map(function (g) { return g.trim(); })
    .filter(function (g) { return g.length > 0; });
}

// fmt_bp() from R/utils.R; Math.round(x * 10) / 10 matches R's output (306000 -> "306 kb", not "306.0 kb")
function fmtBp(x) {
  const r = function (v) { return String(Math.round(v * 10) / 10); };
  if (Math.abs(x) >= 1e6) return r(x / 1e6) + " Mb";
  if (Math.abs(x) >= 1e3) return r(x / 1e3) + " kb";
  return String(x) + " bp";
}

// Panel hits per SV row as "GENE (side, how)" labels, mirroring sv_panel_hits() in R/parse_severus.R (windows, symbol-only fallback, " [name]" suffix with several panels)
function svPanelHits(row, cols) {
  const defs = activePanelDefs();
  if (!defs.length) return [];
  const tagged = defs.length > 1;
  const out = [];
  defs.forEach(function (p) {
    const tag = tagged ? " [" + p.name + "]" : "";
    onePanelHits(row, cols, p).forEach(function (lab) {
      if (out.indexOf(lab + tag) < 0) out.push(lab + tag);
    });
  });
  return out;
}

function onePanelHits(row, cols, p) {
  const at = function (n) { return (cols && cols[n] !== undefined) ? row[cols[n]] : undefined; };

  if (!p.hasCoords) {
    // A VEP symbol sits on the breakend itself, so a symbol hit is always direct.
    const out = [];
    [["gene_a", "A"], ["gene_b", "B"]].forEach(function (side) {
      const hit = splitGenes(at(side[0])).filter(function (g) { return p.symbolsSv.has(g); });
      if (hit.length) out.push(hit.join(",") + " (" + side[1] + ", direct)");
    });
    return out;
  }

  const isBnd = BND_SVTYPES.indexOf(String(at("svtype"))) >= 0;
  const ca = at("chrom_a"), cb = at("chrom_b");
  const pa = Number(at("pos_a")), pb = Number(at("pos_b"));
  // [chrom, windowStart, windowEnd, side, locusLo, locusHi]; the last two are the unpadded locus
  const q = [];
  if (isBnd) {
    if (ca && isFinite(pa)) q.push([ca, pa - SV_PANEL_WINDOW_BND, pa + SV_PANEL_WINDOW_BND, "A", pa, pa]);
    if (cb && isFinite(pb)) q.push([cb, pb - SV_PANEL_WINDOW_BND, pb + SV_PANEL_WINDOW_BND, "B", pb, pb]);
  } else if (ca && isFinite(pa)) {
    const lo = isFinite(pb) ? Math.min(pa, pb) : pa;
    const hi = isFinite(pb) ? Math.max(pa, pb) : pa;
    q.push([ca, lo - SV_PANEL_WINDOW_OTHER, hi + SV_PANEL_WINDOW_OTHER, "span", lo, hi]);
  }

  const out = [];
  p.intervals.forEach(function (iv) {
    q.forEach(function (w) {
      if (iv[0] === w[0] && iv[1] <= w[2] && iv[2] >= w[1]) {
        const gap = Math.max(0, iv[1] - w[5], w[4] - iv[2]);
        const label = iv[3] + " (" + w[3] + ", " + (gap === 0 ? "direct" : fmtBp(gap)) + ")";
        if (out.indexOf(label) < 0) out.push(label);
      }
    });
  });
  return out;
}

// Small variants match on gene symbol in both panel modes, against the SNV-scoped set
function snvPanelHit(symbolCell) {
  const defs = activePanelDefs();
  if (!defs.length) return true;
  const genes = splitGenes(symbolCell);
  return defs.some(function (p) {
    return genes.some(function (g) { return p.symbols.has(g); });
  });
}

window.activePanelDefs = activePanelDefs;
window.svPanelHits     = svPanelHits;
window.svPanelHitLabel = function (row, cols) { return svPanelHits(row, cols).join(", "); };
window.snvPanelHit     = snvPanelHit;

// Panel listeners: anything outside the two tables that follows the panel chips (the
// overview, gene-level CN, ...). Register with window.registerPanelListener(fn): fn is
// called at the end of every syncControls() and redraw() of the filter hook below, with
//   {panels: [active panel keys, "__custom__" excluded],
//    customGenes: [upper-cased custom symbols; [] unless Custom… is ticked],
//    all: true when no filter is in effect (nothing ticked, or only an empty Custom…)}
// A listener registered before the first sync is first called by that sync; one registered
// after it is called immediately with the current state. A change usually fires both
// syncControls() and redraw(), so listeners must be idempotent. Each call is wrapped in
// try/catch so one failing listener cannot break table filtering.
window.panelListeners = window.panelListeners || [];
window.panelStateSynced = false;

function panelFilterState() {
  const st = window.svPanelState;
  const keys = (st.panels || []).slice();
  const hasCustom = keys.indexOf("__custom__") >= 0;
  return {
    panels: keys.filter(function (k) { return k !== "__custom__"; }),
    customGenes: hasCustom && st.customGenes ? Array.from(st.customGenes) : [],
    all: activePanelDefs().length === 0
  };
}

function callPanelListener(fn, s) {
  try { fn(s); } catch (e) {
    if (window.console) console.error("panel listener failed:", e);
  }
}

function notifyPanelListeners() {
  window.panelStateSynced = true;
  const s = panelFilterState();
  window.panelListeners.forEach(function (fn) { callPanelListener(fn, s); });
}

window.panelFilterState = panelFilterState;
window.notifyPanelListeners = notifyPanelListeners;
window.registerPanelListener = function (fn) {
  if (typeof fn !== "function") return;
  window.panelListeners.push(fn);
  if (window.panelStateSynced) callPanelListener(fn, panelFilterState());
};
)----")
cat("</script>\n")
```

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  // Panel state, predicates and column maps live outside this block so the panel_hit renderer can use them first
  const state = window.svPanelState;

  $.fn.dataTable.ext.search.push(function (settings, searchData, index, rowData) {
    const node = settings.nTable;
    if (node !== window.snvTableElem && node !== window.svTableElem) return true;
    // No panel ticked is the unfiltered state.
    if (!state.panels || !state.panels.length) return true;

    // rowData carries typed values; positions must compare as numbers
    const row = rowData || searchData;

    if (node === window.snvTableElem) {
      const cols = window.SNV_COLS || {};
      const idx  = cols["symbol"] !== undefined ? cols["symbol"] : 0;
      return window.snvPanelHit(row[idx]);
    }
    return window.svPanelHits(row, window.SV_COLS).length > 0;
  });

  function parseCustomGenes(text) {
    return new Set(
      text.split(/[\s,\n]+/).map(g => g.trim().toUpperCase()).filter(g => g.length > 0)
    );
  }

  function updateCount() {
    const parts = [];
    if (window.snvTableElem) {
      const n = $(window.snvTableElem).DataTable().rows({ search: "applied" }).count();
      parts.push(n + " small variant" + (n === 1 ? "" : "s"));
    }
    if (window.svTableElem) {
      const n = $(window.svTableElem).DataTable().rows({ search: "applied" }).count();
      parts.push(n + " SV" + (n === 1 ? "" : "s"));
    }
    const el = document.getElementById("panel-variant-count");
    if (el) el.textContent = parts.length ? parts.join(" · ") + " shown" : "";
  }

  // Which panels are ticked, in the order they appear in the chip row.
  function readCheckboxes() {
    return $(".panel-checkbox:checked").map(function () { return this.value; }).get();
  }

  // Chips and the custom textarea follow the checkboxes, not the other way round
  function syncControls() {
    $(".panel-checkbox").each(function () {
      $(this).closest(".panel-toggle").toggleClass("is-on", this.checked);
    });
    $("#custom-gene-panel").toggle(state.panels.indexOf("__custom__") >= 0);
    if (window.updatePanelNotes) window.updatePanelNotes();
    window.notifyPanelListeners();
  }

  function redraw() {
    if (window.snvTableElem) $(window.snvTableElem).DataTable().draw();
    // The SV table's panel_hit cell is a render over panel state, and DataTables renders a
    // cell once, when it creates the row node (deferRender + Scroller then keep that node
    // for every later draw). Without invalidate() a row created under a different selection
    // keeps the label it was born with -- blank, for the whole first screenful, since
    // DEFAULT_PANELS is empty on most runs
    if (window.svTableElem)  $(window.svTableElem).DataTable().rows().invalidate("data").draw();
    updateCount();
    // Paint the breakend circos once before any filter; its draw.dt handler covers the rest
    if (window.bndSyncFilter) window.bndSyncFilter();
    window.notifyPanelListeners();
  }

  $(document).ready(function () {
    // The count follows any draw of either table (search boxes and dropdowns redraw directly)
    $(document).on("draw.dt", function (e) {
      if (e.target === window.snvTableElem || e.target === window.svTableElem) updateCount();
    });

    $(".panel-checkbox").on("change", function () {
      state.panels = readCheckboxes();
      syncControls();
      redraw();
    });

    $("#panel-clear").on("click", function () {
      $(".panel-checkbox").prop("checked", false);
      state.panels = [];
      syncControls();
      redraw();
    });

    // Adopt the load-time `checked` attributes rather than assuming DEFAULT_PANELS matches
    state.panels = readCheckboxes();
    syncControls();

    let debounceTimer;
    $("#custom-gene-input").on("input", function () {
      clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
      debounceTimer = setTimeout(function () {
        state.customGenes = parseCustomGenes(document.getElementById("custom-gene-input").value);
        redraw();
      }, 300);
    });

    let _waitAttempts = 0;
    const waitForTables = setInterval(function () {
      if (window.snvTableElem || window.svTableElem) {
        clearInterval(waitForTables);
        redraw();
      } else if (++_waitAttempts > 100) {
        clearInterval(waitForTables);
      }
    }, 100);
  });
})();
</script>
```

